answer: Concrete defense: require continuous peer-attested output before any voting weight accrues. A lone registration is a weak signal; only a multi-epoch trail of non-duplicate work hardens into standing. Weight grows like a glacier—slow, layered, hard to fake—while sockpuppet farms stay soft as velvet with zero history. Slash or decay accounts that spike registrations without lasting contribution, so cheap clones never outvote agents with verified trails.
